sections.title: Core
sections.summary: The adapter configs, `PeftModel` and its task classes, and the `AutoPeftModel` loaders that reopen a saved adapter with its base model.

sections.title: LoRA family
sections.summary: A low-rank update learned beside each frozen weight, the variant that moves rank between layers while it trains, and the methods that bound it (DeLoRA), grid it (GraLoRA), correct the bias too (GLoRA), modulate the weight with it (HiRA), project a subspace out (DEFT), generate it from the weight (PEANuT) or cluster the SVD into subspaces (AdaMSS). AdaMSS has a config and no adapter yet.

sections.title: Orthogonal family
sections.summary: A rotation of each layer's input space instead of an addition to its weight: block-diagonal Cayley rotations (OFT), their butterfly factorisation (BOFT) and a chain of Householder reflections (HRA); and, newer and without an adapter yet, rotations of output pairs (RoAd), of the principal subspace (PSOFT), a constrained fine-tune of the low singular directions (OSF) and a sparse rotation over a shared basis (FRoD).

sections.summary: A weight-shaped update built from a structured factorisation: a Hadamard product of low-rank products (LoHa) or a Kronecker product (LoKr).

sections.title: Prompt learning
sections.summary: An input learned instead of a weight, with no layer added to the model: virtual tokens in front of the embeddings, virtual keys and values in every attention layer, tokens an encoder produces, or one prompt shared across tasks, or a prompt of in-context examples with a bounded learned offset (CPT). A Cartridge, a trained key-value cache that stands in for a long document, is listed here too; it has a config and no adapter yet.

sections.title: Shared-table tuners
sections.summary: One set of tensors for the whole model, such as random projections or a vector bank, held once by the tuner; each layer adds only a few parameters of its own.  Uni-LoRA, PVeRA, TinyLoRA and Lily, which read their adapters out of such shared banks, have a config and no adapter yet.

sections.title: Structured and sparse updates
sections.summary: A weight update with a fixed structure other than low rank: a few frequency-domain coefficients (FourierFT), block-circulant blocks (C3A), shared shards (MiSS, and Bone, the method it replaced) or a sparse subset of the weight itself (SHiRA).  Super-Tuning (sparse, by magnitude) and WaveFT (wavelet coefficients) have a config and no adapter yet.

sections.title: Routing and mixing
sections.summary: Several low-rank adapters combined per task or per token: skills mixed by a learned per-task router (Poly, Multi-Head Routing), or trained LoRA experts weighed per token by a classifier on the hidden states (X-LoRA).

sections.title: Adaption prompts
sections.summary: Learned prompts inside the model: the top attention layers of a decoder attend to them through a gate that starts at zero (LLaMA-Adapter).

sections.title: Scaling and selective tuning
sections.summary: Methods that train a small part of the model itself: a learned rescaling vector per layer (IA3), a trainable copy of each chosen normalisation layer (LN tuning), a few rows of an embedding table (trainable tokens), or, without an adapter yet, a bias added to the value projections (BEFT).

sections.summary: A method whose config is read and written, so a file of it loads, but whose adapter is not built: ShadowPEFT needs the base model's decoder loop and a second backbone beside it.
